<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: right">
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION&#160;&#160;FY2011 Financial Summary<br>
</font><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">(Consolidated financial information has been prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America)</font></font></div>

<br>
</div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 18pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">1. Business Results</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 30pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">(1)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Consolidated Financial Results for FY2011</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Financial Results</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.7pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Reviewing FY2011, the world economy is improving mainly due to the effect of the expansion of domestic demands and exports in emerging countries especially in Asia, and the economic stimulus measures undertaken by various countries. Although the Japanese economy has gained momentum from improved corporate revenues and rallies in exports and production, it is still facing dire challenges linked to the persistently low employment figures and to the weakened economic activity resulting from the impact of the Great East Japan Earthquake.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.7pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">For automobile industry, market has expanded especially in emerging countries such as China, and technological development and new product launches have been accelerated, caused by increase of customers&#8217; demands for the compact cars and low-price cars, and growth of worldwide environmental consciousness.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial"><font style="DISPLAY: inline">Under these conditions, consolidated vehicle sales in Japan and overseas increased by 71 thousand units, or 1.0%, to 7,308 thousand units in FY2011 compared with FY</font>2010<font style="DISPLAY: inline"> (April 1, 2009 through March 31, 2010).&#160;&#160;Vehicle sales in Japan decreased by 250 thousand units, or 11.5%, to 1,913 thousand units in FY2011 compared with FY2010 under the declined market in Japan.&#160;&#160;However, with the efforts of dealers nationwide, </font>Toyota and Lexus brands&#8217; market share excluding mini-vehicles was 47.3%, and <font style="DISPLAY: inline">market share (including Daihatsu and </font>Hino brands) including mini-vehicles<font style="DISPLAY: inline"> was </font>43.7<font style="DISPLAY: inline">%,</font> each remained at a high level following FY2010.&#160;&#160;Meanwhile, overseas vehicle sales <font style="DISPLAY: inline">increased</font> by 321 thousand units, or 6.3%, to 5,395 thousand units in <font style="DISPLAY: inline">FY2011 compared with FY</font>2010, because of the sales expansion in Asia and other regions.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">As for the results of operations, net revenues increased by 42.7<font style="DISPLAY: inline"> billion yen, or </font>0.2<font style="DISPLAY: inline">%, to </font>18,993.6<font style="DISPLAY: inline"> billion yen in FY2011 compared with FY</font>2010<font style="DISPLAY: inline">, and operating income increased by </font>320.7<font style="DISPLAY: inline"> billion yen, or 217.4%, to </font>468.2<font style="DISPLAY: inline"> billion yen in FY2011 compared with FY</font>2010<font style="DISPLAY: inline">.&#160;&#160;</font>Among the factors contributing to an increase in operating income were <font style="DISPLAY: inline">t</font>he effects of marketing efforts <font style="DISPLAY: inline">of 490.0 billion yen and </font>cost reduction efforts of 180.0 billion yen.<font style="DISPLAY: inline">&#160;</font>On the other hand, <font style="DISPLAY: inline">factors resulting in a decrease in operating income primarily included the effects of changes in exchange rates of 290.0 billion yen,</font> an increase in expense of 30.0 billion yen, and other factors of <font style="DISPLAY: inline">29.3</font> billion yen<font style="DISPLAY: inline">.&#160;&#160;Income before income taxes and equity in earnings of affiliated companies increased by 271.8 billion yen, or </font>93.3<font style="DISPLAY: inline">%, to 563.2 billion yen in FY2011 compared with FY</font>2010<font style="DISPLAY: inline">.&#160;&#160;</font>Net income attributable to Toyota Motor Corporation<font style="DISPLAY: inline"> increased by 198.7 billion yen, or </font>94.9<font style="DISPLAY: inline">%, to 408.1 billion yen in FY2011 compared with FY</font>2010<font style="DISPLAY: inline">.</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Net revenues for the automotive operations increased by 139.9 billion yen, or 0.8%, to 17,337.3 billion yen in FY2011 compared with FY2010, and operating income increased by 172.3 billion yen to 86.0 billion yen in FY2011 compared with FY2010.&#160;&#160;The increase in operating income was mainly due to cost reduction efforts and increases in both production volume and vehicle unit sales, despite the effects of changes in exchange rates.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Net revenues for the financial services operations decreased by 53.2 billion yen, or 4.3%, to 1,192.2 billion yen in FY2011 compared with FY2010. <font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">&#12288;</font>However, operating income increased by 111.3 billion yen, or 45.1%, to 358.2 billion yen in FY2011 compared with FY2010.&#160;&#160;The increase in operating income was mainly due to a decrease in the provision for credit losses in sales finance subsidiaries.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Toyota Motor Corporation (&#8220;TMC&#8221;) deems the benefit of its shareholders as one of its priority management policies, and it is working to improve corporate structure towards the realization of sustainable growth in order to enhance its corporate value.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">TMC will strive to continue to pay stable dividends while giving due consideration to factors such as business results for each term, investment plans and its cash reserves.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">In order to successfully compete in this highly competitive industry, TMC plans to utilize its internal funds for the early commercialization of technologies for the next-generation environment and safety, giving priority to customer safety and sense of security.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Considering these factors, with respect to the dividends for FY2011, TMC plans to propose a year-end dividend of&#160;30 yen per share, and an annual dividend of&#160;50 yen per share, combined with the interim dividend of&#160;20 yen per share.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">TMC pays dividends twice a year &#8211; an interim dividend and a year-end dividend &#8211;, and in order to secure an opportunity to directly seek shareholders&#8217; opinions, TMC will treat payments of year-end dividends as a matter to be resolved at the 107th Ordinary General Shareholders&#8217; Meeting, even though TMC&#8217;s articles of incorporation stipulate that retained earnings can be distributed as dividends pursuant to the resolution of the board of directors.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">In FY2011, TMC did not repurchase its own shares, excluding shares constituting less than one unit that were purchased by TMC upon request.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Going forward, in view of the uncertain condition of the global economy, TMC will not repurchase its own shares for the time being to prioritize securing its cash reserves.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 18pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">2. Management Policy</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left">
<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">&#160;</div>

<div>
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left">
<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: arial">
<tr valign="top">
<td style="WIDTH: 27pt">&#160;</td>
<td align="right" style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">(1)</font></div>
</td>
<td style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify">
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Toyota&#8217;s Basic Management Policy</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">&#8220;Management Policy&#8221; has been omitted, as there were no significant changes from the matters disclosed in the &#8220;Financial Summary&#8221; for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2007 (released on May 9, 2007).</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">The aforementioned information is available on the following Web sites.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Toyota Web site:</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">http://www.toyota.co.jp</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Tokyo Stock Exchange Group, Inc. Web site (listed company search page):</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">http://www.tse.or.jp/listing/compsearch/index.html</font> (Japanese only)</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">&#160;</div>

<div>
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left">
<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: arial">
<tr valign="top">
<td style="WIDTH: 27pt">&#160;</td>
<td align="right" style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="FONT-WEIGHT: normal"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: normal; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: arial">(2)</font></font></font></div>
</td>
<td align="left">
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="FONT-WEIGHT: normal"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: normal; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: arial">Medium- and Long-term Management Strategy</font></font></font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">The Toyota Group as a whole will make an even greater effort to address the following in order to realize two of Toyota&#8217;s enduring wishes: &#8220;to be a company customers choose&#8221; and &#8220;to bring smiles to every customer who chooses Toyota.&#8221;</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">First, in product development, we intend to proceed with substantial improvement in design and perceived quality and the establishment of organization by which products launched at a certain region will be developed based on the customer needs of such region. For &#8220;Eco-Cars&#8221;, we will make all-around efforts to expand our product line-up of hybrid vehicles and develop next-generation eco-cars such as plug-in hybrid vehicles, electric vehicles and fuel cell vehicles, along with the high-efficiency gasoline engine.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Second, as for &#8220;emerging markets&#8221; with strong promise for future growth, we intend to reinforce core models for local production such as IMV and newly developed compact vehicles, while launching more hybrid vehicles. Through these efforts, we will build a well-balanced business structure that impartially allocates resources to both developed countries and emerging countries.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left">&#160;</div>

<div>
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left">
<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: arial">
<tr valign="top">
<td style="WIDTH: 36pt">&#160;</td>
<td align="right" style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">(*)</font></div>
</td>
<td style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify">
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">IMV is an abbreviation for Innovative International Multi-purpose Vehicle, which refers to sport-utility vehicles (SUVs), pickup trucks, and other multi-purpose vehicles that is produced overseas for markets worldwide.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Third, to quickly reflect feedback from our customers around the world in our R&amp;D, production and sales operations, we will build a structure wherein decisions can be made regionally, in areas closest to the customers.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Fourth, we will further reinforce three basic functions: quality improvement, cost reduction, and human resource development.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Based on these efforts, Toyota will contribute to realize &#8220;enriching lives of communities&#8221; through manufacturing &#8220;good automobiles&#8221; that is accepted by customers and society. This will encourage more customers to well-purchase Toyota cars and thereby lead to the establishment of a stable business base. By perpetuating this good cycle, we will aim to realize &#8220;sustainable growth&#8221; and enhance corporate value. And, full observance of corporate ethics such as compliance with applicable laws and regulations, Toyota will fulfill its social responsibilities by carrying out its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR).</font></div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left">&#160;</div>

<div>
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 18pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">(6)&#160; </font><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Summary of Significant Accounting Policies</font></div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 18pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">&#8220;Summary of significant accounting policies&#8221; has been omitted, as there were no significant changes from the most recent Securities Report (filed on June 25, 2010).&#160;&#160;Changes in accounting principles, procedures, and disclosures for consolidated financial statements by newly issued accounting pronouncements are set forth below.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">In June 2009, the Financial Accounting Standards Board (&#8220;FASB&#8221;) issued updated guidance of accounting for and disclosure of transfers and servicing. This guidance eliminates the concept of a qualifying special-purpose entity, changes the requirements for derecognizing financial assets, and requires additional disclosures about transfers of financial assets. Toyota and its consolidated subsidiaries (&#8220;Toyota&#8221;) adopted this guidance from the interim period within the fiscal year begun after November 15, 2009. The adoption of this guidance did not have a material impact on Toyota&#8217;s consolidated financial statements.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">In June 2009, FASB issued updated guidance of accounting for and disclosure of consolidation. This guidance changes how a company determines when a variable interest entity should be consolidated. Toyota adopted this guidance from fiscal year begun after November 15, 2009. The adoption of this guidance did not have a material impact on Toyota&#8217;s consolidated financial statements.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 22.55pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">In July 2010, FASB issued updated disclosure guidance on receivables. This guidance requires additional disclosures about the credit quality of financing receivables and the allowance for credit losses. Toyota adopted this guidance from the fiscal year ended March 31, 2011. The adoption of this guidance did not have a material impact on Toyota&#8217;s consolidated financial statements.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="center"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Notice Concerning the Partial Amendment of the Articles of Incorporation</font></font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We hereby give notification that, at the meeting of the Board of Directors of Toyota Motor Corporation (&#8220;TMC&#8221;) held on May 11, 2011, TMC has decided to propose a partial amendment of its Articles of Incorporation at its 107th Ordinary General Shareholders&#8217; Meeting scheduled to be held on June 17, 2011, as described below.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">1. Reason for Amendment</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 27pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The position of the Senior Managing Director will be discontinued and the number of directors of the board will be reduced in accordance with changes in the management structure. The changes are intended to enhance prompt management decision-making and agile management to respond to the changing business environment.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">1. Timeline for production recovery</font></div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: arial">

<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">Production is expected to normalize in stages, starting in June, on global basis, rather than starting in July in Japan and in August outside Japan as announced on April 22, 2011.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
